limits_of_evidence: The explicit nonempty content low quality, blurry ran through the actual CFG-4 negative argument; it was not an execution or loader option and was never replaced by a proxy.
Completed nonempty Refine was measured at strength 0.125, 30 full steps, CFG 4 and 1024 square; negative strength 0.4 was exercised only through callback-one cancellation.
One original source and seed 4471 per variant were used. There is no enlargement, other aspect, hardware, platform, quantization or offload measurement here.

Root inspected the new negative-0125 image of each variant. Empty/control findings are inherited only after full RGB equality with earlier reviewed images; repeats/recovery are inherited only after full equality with the new negative image.
Existing geometry/anatomy imperfections remain. These observations are not Matt acceptance, author advice or a universal claim that a negative phrase improves quality.
The record establishes measured branch response, reproduction, cancellation and cleanup; public API/profile admission is a separate integration decision.
